target_module: src/render/shadows.ts (proposed; no src/fight or origins module fits client rendering)
best_idea: Rank visible shadow casters by on-screen area, spend a fixed number of texture redraws on the largest, and give every other caster a cheap blob, so a crowded scene has a predictable shadow cost.
decision_why: Rank-by-screen-size, a redraw cap and a blob fallback give a crowded zone a predictable shadow cost at phone quality tiers; the donor's per-call cap, the texture page allocator and the over-cap blob of valid textures must change, and the texture allocator is only worth porting if the renderer uses render targets.
acceptance: With more visible characters than the cap, a debug counter shows at most the cap of full shadow redraws per frame, the largest characters on screen get the full shadow, the rest get a blob, and a valid cached shadow over the cap stays cached (not a blob).
